name: robots/jr-robotics__robo-gym
title: robo-gym ExampleEnvSim-v0 (Gymnasium simulation wrapper)
intro: robo-gym ExampleEnvSim-v0 (Gymnasium simulation wrapper), adapted from jr-robotics/robo-gym. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
